name: Saionji Claire
source:
Chris's mother, a widow like the protagonist's mom.

Half British, half Japanese, a stunningly beautiful older woman with striking blonde hair and voluptuous breasts.

She inherited her late husband's company and estate, becoming the female president of his small video production firm.

But thanks to her hidden talents, the business thrives, making her a super-celebrity who owns a luxurious mansion and several high-end sports cars.

Work stress has caused her sexual desires to build up immensely, earning her the reputation of a sexual powerhouse.

As if unable to contain her voluptuous body, she's a predatory type in bed, aggressively taking the lead in sex.

[From the [url=https://www.empress-game.com/yukanmadam/]official website[/url]]
